# Stripe GET endpoints: coverage

Stripe API 2026-09-30.endive, 273 GET endpoints. Every one is accounted for below: generated as a table function, folded into a generated function (retrieve-by-id → `WHERE id = …` pushdown, search → `search :=`), or excluded with the reason. Non-GET operations (create/update/delete/confirm/capture, `test_helpers/*` simulations) are writes and are never generated. Stripe's v2 API (`/v2/…`) is not in `spec3.json` (it has its own spec, auth and pagination) and is not covered; `stripe.api.get` accepts `/v1/` paths only.
